title: Node.js is vulnerable to a remotely triggerable uncaught exception in TLS servers via deferred handshake callbacks…
description: Node.js versions 24.x and 26.x contain a vulnerability in TLS server handshake handling where deferred OpenSSL callbacks do not properly handle socket destruction. This can cause a remote, unauthenticated attacker to trigger an uncaught exception that terminates the server process. The issue arises when using certain TLS hooks such as SNICallback, OCSPRequest, newSession, resumeSession, or server.addContext().
